overview: The committee discussed the logistical necessity of modular classrooms during the Medford High School building project, focusing on the educational disruptions inherent in phased reconstruction.

items.title: Modular Classroom Requirements and Logistics
items.summary: Matt Rice explained that modular classrooms are required for any renovation scenario to accommodate approximately 50 classrooms displaced as the building wings are reconstructed in phases.

items.title: Impact on Career and Technical Education (CTE)
items.summary: The discussion addressed the unique challenges of relocating CTE programs, noting that specialized shops like auto tech may require off-site community partnerships and student busing during construction.

items.title: Disruption Analysis of Project Options
items.summary: Participants identified Option B 1.2 as highly disruptive because its focus on the existing building footprint prevents moving students into new permanent structures early in the project timeline.
